findings.rationale: Accepted: the plan contradicted itself; write-after-successful-claim adopted everywhere (2.6, 3, KR3, D2, 6) as the frozen rubric says; the unlink path is gone.

Accepted: the two-intake race (A creates, B EEXIST-accepts and claims, A rejected and unlinks) is real under O_EXCL-only signals; write-after-claim makes file ⇒ held claim and removes the race; the claim-without-file resume rule covers the crash window.

Accepted, option (a): on digest mismatch rebuild the live snapshot from the same contract and list every carried field whose value differs, with stored and recomputed digests; the block reason stays the digest mismatch.

Accepted: terminalizeWallExpiry only after the allSettled join; worst-case extra wall = sibling's precomputed deadline (bounded by the pocket); the process-survival check moves to the first live post-merge campaign; unit suite asserts receipt shape.
Accepted: station_overlap.suite_failed_during_overlap flag; pre-merge hold when the serial full_suite baseline is within 20 % of the unreserved remainder.

Accepted and verified at base: every ledger row is built by ledgerEntry (autopilot-engine.js:2950-2957) with started_at/ended_at — full_suite :8254, campaign_verification :8168/:8193, panel dispatch_review :5491/:5738; written into §0; stop-and-re-plan clause kept only as the guard it already is.
Accepted: the injection seam is the AutopilotEngine({clock}) constructor option consumed by this.now(); named in §0; the base block payload is recorded beside the RED comment.
